subjectLine: Iran-Backed Hackers Hit Medical Devices + Critical 5G Indoor Cell Flaw Exposed

articles.title: Iran-Linked APT Group Compromises Medical Device Manufacturer
articles.summary: A sophisticated threat actor with ties to Iran's IRGC breached a major medical device company, gaining access to firmware update systems. The attack could potentially affect thousands of connected hospital devices across North America and Europe.

articles.title: CISA Issues Emergency Directive for Critical Infrastructure Zero-Day
articles.summary: CISA has released an emergency directive ordering all federal agencies to patch a critical zero-day vulnerability actively exploited in the wild. The flaw affects a widely-deployed network management platform used across government and private sectors.

articles.title: Critical Vulnerability Found in 5G Indoor Small Cell Controllers
articles.summary: Security researchers discovered a critical remote code execution vulnerability in a popular 5G indoor small cell controller used by multiple telecom carriers. The flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to gain root access to the cell management interface.

articles.title: NMS Platform Vulnerability Exposes Thousands of Network Devices
articles.summary: A newly disclosed SQL injection vulnerability in a leading network management system could allow attackers to extract credentials for managed devices. Patches are available and immediate updating is recommended.

articles.title: New Ransomware Gang Targets Healthcare with Double Extortion
articles.summary: A new ransomware group dubbed 'MedusaLock' has emerged, specifically targeting healthcare organizations with a double extortion model — encrypting systems while threatening to leak patient data on their dark web portal.

articles.title: Google Patches Actively Exploited Chrome Zero-Day
articles.summary: Google released an emergency update for Chrome to patch a type confusion vulnerability in the V8 JavaScript engine that was being actively exploited. Users should update to version 135.0.6998.88 immediately.

articles.title: Security Now Episode 972: The State of Post-Quantum Cryptography
articles.summary: Steve Gibson covers the latest NIST post-quantum cryptography standards and their real-world implementation challenges. Gibson explains why organizations need to start planning their quantum-safe migration strategy now.
